desc: Build and maintain the software robotics teams use day to day — rosters, scouting, and season tooling — and hand it to teams for free.
Ramp newer teammates onto the codebase and the build process, from first pull request to competition-day debugging.
Run capture-the-flag practice sessions for students getting into security, and maintain the platform that hosts the challenges.
Help run a community site for algorithm and competitive-programming practice, including write-ups and problem sets.
